extracted.name: Cucumber Slices with Dill
extracted.description: This cucumber salad with dill is quick and easy to prepare and placed in the refrigerator for the flavors to meld before being served chilled.
instruction_lines: Combine cucumbers, onion, and dill in a large serving bowl.
Combine sugar, vinegar, water, and salt in a medium bowl; stir until sugar dissolves.
Pour vinegar mixture over cucumber mixture. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving
